__inputs.name: DS_LOKI
__inputs.label: Loki
__inputs.description: Loki data source holding cannonball-se game event logs

description: Browse any recent Cannonball-SE game. Click a row in the 'Recent games' table (Loki, one row per game, newest first) to load it — every panel below is scoped to that game via session_label, exact at ANY time range. Widen the range to browse further back; Loki keeps full history (no Tempo tag-values cap). Unlike 'Now Playing' this does NOT auto-follow — you choose the game. Loki-only: no Tempo dependency. Generated from live_game_dashboard.json by generate.py — edit the live board, then regenerate. Requires grafana-graphviz-panel and marcusolsson-dynamictext-panel.

panels.title: Recent games — click a row to view
panels.description: Every game seen in the current time range, newest first (session_label sorts lexically by its timestamp prefix). Click a row to load that game into the panels below. Widen the time range to browse further back — Loki keeps full history, with none of the Tempo tag-values cap the old picker suffered.

panels.title: Game state
panels.description: completion_code of the selected session: 1 = COMPLETED, 2 = TIMED OUT, null = IN PROGRESS (no end yet).

panels.title: Stage reached
panels.description: Highest stage_number reached in the selected session.

panels.title: Off-road
panels.description: Number of times the car went off-road (game.off_road events) in the selected game.

panels.title: Avg speed
panels.description: Mean speed_kph across this session's events. NOTE: speed_kph is only logged on crash / off-road / stage-start / route / overtake events, so this is a sampled average weighted toward eventful moments, not a true whole-lap mean.

panels.title: Top speed
panels.description: Highest speed_kph seen across any event in this session.

panels.title: Score
panels.description: Latest score for the selected game — updates through the game via in-game events (crashes, overtakes, route choices).

panels.title: Crashes by type
panels.description: Crash count grouped by crash_type (bump / spin / flip) for the selected session.

targets.expression: SELECT t.label AS crash_type, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS crashes FROM (SELECT 'bump' AS ct, 'Bump' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'flip','Flip' UNION ALL SELECT 'spin','Spin') t LEFT JOIN (SELECT crash_type, `__value__` AS cnt FROM A) a ON a.crash_type = t.ct ORDER BY crashes DESC

panels.title: Overtakes by vehicle
panels.description: Overtake count grouped by vehicle (porsche, corvette, bmw, beetle, pickup, truck).

panels.title: Fastest crash
panels.description: Speed (km/h) of the fastest crash in the selected game — max speed_kph over game.crash events.

panels.title: Route taken (map)
panels.description: The OutRun map. Nodes visited by the selected session are populated with a visit count via the panel's node-id matching (node id = stage_id). Every stage 1-5 emits game.stage.start, including Coconut Beach (stage_id 0), so the whole route populates. Tip: add a Node override coloured by the injected value to fully highlight the path.

targets.expression: SELECT DISTINCT s.sid AS stage_id, CASE WHEN s.sid = (SELECT sid FROM (SELECT Line AS sid, `Time` AS t FROM A) q ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1) AND (SELECT Line FROM B LIMIT 1) = 'timeout' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS status FROM (SELECT Line AS sid FROM A) s
SELECT CONCAT(prev,'__to__',sid) AS edge_id, 1 AS taken FROM (SELECT sid, lag(sid) OVER (ORDER BY t ASC) AS prev FROM (SELECT `Time` AS t, Line AS sid FROM A) q1) q2 WHERE prev IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Final frame (game over)
panels.description: The game.session.end screenshot for the selected session. Caption shows completion status.

panels.title: Course map
panels.description: The game.map_screen capture for the selected session (route overview).

panels.title: Screenshots (in order)
panels.description: Every screenshot captured during the game, in the order it occurred (oldest first).

panels.title: Player
panels.description: player_initials of the selected game.

panels.title: Overtakes by color
panels.description: Overtake count grouped by the overtaken vehicle's color.

panels.title: Total events
panels.description: Total game events (log lines) captured for the selected game.

panels.title: Music
panels.description: music_selection for the selected game (numeric for now; track-name mappings TBD).

panels.title: Total crashes
panels.description: Total crashes in the selected game.

panels.title: Total overtakes
panels.description: Total vehicles overtaken in the selected game.

panels.title: Game duration
panels.description: Wall-clock duration of the selected game (session.end epoch minus session.start epoch).

targets.expr: (max(max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range])) - max(max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))) / 1000

panels.title: Overall Rank
panels.description: This game's rank by final score among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = highest score).

targets.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

panels.title: Longest clean streak
panels.description: Longest continuous stretch of clean driving (no crash / off-road) in the selected game, in seconds.

panels.title: Longest time played
panels.description: Rank by game duration among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = longest).

targets.expr: (max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range])) - max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))) / 1000

(max(max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range])) - max(max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))) / 1000

targets.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

panels.title: Most overtakes
panels.description: Rank by total overtakes among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = most).

targets.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

panels.title: Average speed
panels.description: Rank by average speed (km/h) among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = fastest).

targets.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

panels.title: Longest clean streak
panels.description: Rank by longest clean-driving streak among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = longest).

targets.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

panels.title: Fastest overtake
panels.description: Top speed (km/h) at which an overtake happened in the selected game.

panels.title: Fastest overtake rank
panels.description: Rank by fastest overtake speed among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = fastest).

targets.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

panels.title: Time per stage
panels.description: Total game time split by stage — each segment is the wall-clock seconds spent on that stage (stage_duration_seconds on game.stage.end, incl. the final stage to game over).

targets.expr: max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="1" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))
max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="2" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))
max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="3" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))
max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="4" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))
max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="5" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))

panels.title: Overtake speeds
panels.description: Overtakes bucketed by speed (10 km/h bins) in the selected game.

targets.expression: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(Line AS DOUBLE)/10)*10 AS CHAR) AS speed_kmh, COUNT(*) AS overtakes FROM A GROUP BY speed_kmh ORDER BY speed_kmh

panels.title: Checkpoint time buffer
panels.description: Seconds left on the clock at each checkpoint (game.stage.end time_remaining_seconds). One bar per completed stage.

targets.expr: max by (stage_number) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | unwrap time_remaining_seconds [$__range]))

panels.title: Score progression
panels.description: Points scored in each stage (score_end - score_start on the stage events), stacked to the final score.

targets.expr: (max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="1" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="1" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))

(max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="2" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="2" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))

(max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="3" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="3" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))

(max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="4" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="4" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))

(max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="5" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="5" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))
